images.caption: And here comes another day in "Serra dos Órgãos" National Park in Brazil, when the light from stars and cities slowly gives away to the sunlight. In the distance the Three Peaks in Nova Friburgo-RJ can be seen.

images.caption:
View of the Three Peaks in Nova Friburgo-RJ from "Pedra do Sino" in "Serra dos Órgãos" National Park (Brazil).   
One of the greatest wonders for nature lovers is to camp in the park and watch the sun set and rise again on the other day.
images.alt:
View of the Three Peaks in Nova Friburgo-RJ from "Pedra do Sino" in "Serra dos Órgãos" National Park (Brazil).   
One of the greatest wonders for nature lovers is to camp in the park and watch the sun set and rise again on the other day.
